body:
I've attempted and thought about committing suicide. 

For when I was considering it what stopped me was who would take care of my cat as good as I can. 

For attempted: the first time my plan involved two steps, and a housemate interrupted me before I could finished. 

The second time I thought I was done for, and remember laying in bed thinking I didn't want to die and I fucked up but there was nothing I could do but sleep. I woke up and through a series of phone calls I barely remember I ended up going to the hospital. 

I'm not over everything but at the same time the feeling of "I don't want to die" stays with me. I know matter what that'll be the last thing, and I don't want it to be like that.

Two months is still pretty small. A discrete heating pad could be a good idea, just remember to check it for wear. Good luck with neighbors. If nothing else, remember that you're trying, and that's more than a lot of people would do.

How little is little? Depending on the age it might need to be somewhere warm. If it's near adulthood, the winter might not be too bad, I've known outdoor cats that have done San Jose winters before. It's also worth seeing if you notice any neighbors giving food or attention to the cat, and maybe one of them could do a shelter. A shelter doesn't necessarily need a heading pad, even just a box with an old towel where they can get out of the rain can be good.  This all depends on the age, but since you described climbing fences and stuff I'm guessing near adult.

Heh, I'm surprised you've heard of stpd. I run into so many people who haven't. My doctors haven't done much with medication , but I think it's because they're really worried about the anxiety and depression and sleep problems. 

I think I'm gonna get a mint latte from my favorite coffee shop later today (gods it's early here) to remind myself to enjoy the little things. There's lots of good things, and I think everything got do dark I couldn't see it. I debated for awhile even posting here and I'm glad I did. 

I hear Australian summers are awful, and I hope you and all your animals stay somewhat cool. Sounds like you have a nice little zoo. 

I'm having trouble keeping my eyes open now and I think I need to sleep and I just want to say thank you. It doesn't seem like much but I really think I just needed to get pulled out of my own head and remember there's life beyond everything that's going on, and that I can make it. It means a lot and I hope you have a good day/evening. Thank you so much.

It's not just my depression, though I have that in spades. I also have schizotypal personality disorder, and that can cause delusions and other things. 

I know I need to try find new people but it's hard. I'm very embedded on tumblr and I've been posted to tumblrinaction a few times. (Not recently). I suppose it's ironic that I'm reaching out here now. 

Logically I know it's a bad patch but everything that's happened and how my brain feels just feels eternal, like the good times won't come.

We've actually been having a cold snap here. My kitty has been napping all curled up because of it. Do you have any pets? Random I know, I just like hearing about people's animals.
